Name: OneSprinklerOneScarecrow
Author: Mizzion
TagLine: Adds one new sprinkler and one new scarecrow to the game. If you have at least one "Haxor Sprinkler" and one "Haxarecrow"  placed on your farm, ALL your hoed dirt will be watered, and you'll no longer have to worry about crows.
Description:
Adds one new sprinkler and one new scarecrow to the game. If you have at least one "Haxor Sprinkler" and one "Haxarecrow"  placed on your farm, ALL your hoed dirt will be watered, and you'll no longer have to worry about crows.

**Install Directions**
1. Download the mod
2. Open the zipped file, you should see a folder called  "OneSprinklerOneScarecrow", Place this folder into your "Mods" folder.
3 Open the game. The Sprinkler requires 100 stone, and the scarecrow requires 100 wood.
4. If you want a harder version. Run the game one time with the mod installed, then exit the game and change the config.json files setting to true.

Downloads.Description: Complete re-write of the mod. Look in the Article https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/636 for more info.
